plugin.name: The Punisher Fusion Fix
RawInputMouse.description: Uses Windows raw relative mouse movement. Applies immediately.
TextLanguage.description: Language of the fix’s menu and settings. Auto follows Windows. Reopen the menu to apply.
ResX.description: Override rendering width. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
ResY.description: Override rendering height. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected world-camera FOV from 0.5 to 2.0; larger is wider, up to 150 degrees horizontally. Applies immediately. In-engine cutscenes, portraits and menu views keep their own framing.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the intro sequence. Requires a restart.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect. Applies immediately.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
FPSLimit.description: Limits rendering to 30–1000 FPS. 0 disables the limit; -1 uses the desktop refresh rate. Applies immediately. 60 FPS is recommended for stable game behavior.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, a centered window with the exact rendering size, or a borderless window covering the monitor. Borderless uses the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause while another window is active. Turn off to keep the game running in the background. Applies immediately.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while focused. Release it when another window is active or this option is off. Applies immediately.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keep the game's sliding cutscene borders. Off switches them instantly.
checkupdates.description: Check for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for The Punisher Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for The Punisher Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
